paper_title: Astrophysical limits on very light axion-like particles from Chandra grating spectroscopy of NGC 1275
notes: ALP-photon conversion limit from X-ray transparency of Perseus cluster ICM. 99.7% credible limit g_agamma < 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 (Model-A) and < 7.9e-13 GeV^-1 (Model-B) for m_a < 1e-12 eV. This is an astrophysical (non-DM) bound, so no DM density assumed. Limit applies as a flat upper bound across masses below ~1e-12 eV; only representative endpoints given since no detailed exclusion table provided.
